My work covers 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 and 𝗘𝗨 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗴𝘂𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, with a strong focus on 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗹𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁 and 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝘀𝗮𝗳𝗲𝘁𝘆. My current priorities include shaping the revision of the New Legislative Framework (𝗡𝗟𝗙) and advancing projects to promote the value of Quality Infrastructure (𝗤𝗜) worldwide.

Quality Infrastructure refers to the system of standards, accreditation, conformity assessment, and market surveillance that ensures goods, services and processes meet 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀 of quality, safety and environmental integrity. The TIC (Testing, Inspection, Certification) sector is one of its core pillars, providing 𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗮𝘀𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 that keeps the system credible and effective.

Through my role at TIC Council, I represent the voice of the TIC industry in Brussels, highlighting its contribution to both the European 𝗦𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗹𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁 and the global economy. Our sector underpins 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁 by ensuring that products are safe, reliable and compliant, providing a basis for mutual recognition that facilitates trade, prevents duplication of checks and helps companies access 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝘀 more efficiently.

The Executive Programme in IT Management (EPI) uses a combination of business cases, workshops and lectures delivered by subject matter specialists and academics to build a solid knowledge base in IT management and good business practices for current and future IT and business managers.

GOVERNANCE PRACTICES modules:
G1 - The CIO foundation (result: 79%)
G2 - IT Process improvement workshop (result: 85.5%)
G3 - IT Soft Skills for IT professionals (result: 90%)

IT MANAGEMENT modules:
M1 - Management of Applications Development (result: 85.29%)
M2 - IT Strategy Execution (result: 77%)
M3 - IT Services Management (result: 80%)

Practical info:

Language: English
Classes: 2 evening per week + work group sessions
Period: January 2014 to December 2014

Areas of instruction:

Centred around on organisation, this MA programme has two main focuses: human resource management in its true sense and organisational studies (public and private companies, administrations, associations, etc.) in their main dimensions: the human dimension of management, the legal, budgetary and economic aspects of HR management, as well as training, counselling and intervention methodologies. The programme aims to provide intellectual mechanisms allowing a critical approach to understanding and intervening in the human dimensions of management.

Special features and highlights:

Encouraging the active participation of students (case studies, consulting assignments, workshops, work in groups, discussions with external speakers, residencies, etc.), the programme is designed to give priority to an independent and critical analysis of HR policies and organisational consultancy practices.

profiles.about:
Riva Group ranks as the 5th largest steel producer in Europe by volume and leads in the Electric Arc Furnace (EAF) production route—a highly decarbonized and circular-economy-focused approach to steelmaking. As the Vice-Chair of the EUROFER Energy Committee and Energy Manager at Riva Group, I am committed to advocating for the interests of energy-intensive industries, particularly electricity-intensive sectors. My focus is on ensuring a sustainable, competitive, and resilient future for European industry.

I actively contribute to key policy and strategic dossiers at both European and national levels, including:

- Trade Defense: Safeguarding fair trade practices through anti-dumping, anti-subsidy, and safeguard measures.
- Decarbonization: ETS/CBAM mechanisms for sustainable industrial transformation.
- Circular Economy: Driving recycling and sustainability in steel and allied industries.
- Critical Raw Materials: Addressing supply challenges, particularly in the context of geopolitical disruptions such as the Russian war against Ukraine.

With expertise in energy strategy and industrial policy, I aim to build bridges between industry, policy makers, and society to shape a more sustainable and innovative future for the steel sector.

I’m the CEO & Co-Founder of Sparagus, an Engineering & IT consulting company operating through distributed and cross-border teams.

My role is mainly on the engineering and operational side of the business. I spend my time on how teams are structured, how work is delivered, and how the company grows without creating unnecessary complexity. Most decisions I’m involved in come down to one question: can this be delivered properly, and sustainably?

Over time, I’ve worked closely with engineering and IT consultants across different environments, as well as with clients who value consistency and execution over big promises. That experience has shaped how I think about consulting: less about volume, more about reliability.

I’m not particularly interested in buzzwords or inflated narratives. What matters to me is building systems that hold under pressure, teams that know what’s expected of them, and a company that can grow without losing its balance.

My focus areas today are:

Engineering delivery and operational structure
Distributed and near-shore team models
Long-term scalability of consulting organizations

I focus on building consulting organizations that are meant to last.

profiles.headline: Marketing & Sales enthusiast | personal sales stories and women-in-sales support | Head of Sales at LexisNexis
profiles.about:
Most sales tactics are boring and outdated, agree?

"I feel pushy and salesy when I sell"
"I swear, if I hear the word 'funnel' again..."
"Do I really need to send 100 cold DMs per day?!"

You've probably thought the same thing at some point in your career, right? If you work in Marketing and Sales, chances are... you say these every day :)

But... sales doesn't have to be this "pushy" thing that makes you feel like you're cheating someone out of their hard-earned money.

Sales is human understanding. Psychology at scale.

What if selling didn't feel so salesy?
What if you made "funnels" fun and easy?
What if "sales" was more than just "cold outreach"? 

In my last 20 years working as a Marketing Manager and Head of Sales across companies of different size, I can tell you...

Sales CAN be fun.
Selling IS not that hard.
Marketing IS always needed.

Hey, if you've read this far...

I'm Iryna! Nice to meet you.

In my LinkedIn posts, I share lessons from my last 2 decades in business. And when I'm not on LinkedIn, I train my sales team members on how to a better job at growing the business. And when I'm not in the office, I like to speak on stages as a keynote speaker or look out which podcast I can jump on to talk even more... well... Sales and Marketing!

I love what I do. 

And I hope to share some of this love and lessons with you.

Thanks for reading.

Launched in 2000, the United Nations Global Compact is a call to companies around the world to align their strategies and operations with 10 principles in the areas of human rights, labour, environment and anti-corruption (see: 10 UN Global Compact Principles), to take action in support of broader United Nations (UN) goals and to commit themselves to communicate on their progress (COP). Through the development, implementation, and disclosure of responsible corporate policies and practices, business can help ensure that markets advance in ways that benefit economies and societies everywhere. With more than 12.000 signatories over 145 countries, it is the world’s largest voluntary corporate responsibility initiative.

The UN Global Compact seeks to combine the best properties of the UN, such as moral authority and convening power, with the private sector’s solution-finding strengths and the expertise and capacities of a range of key stakeholders. The initiative is global and local; private and public; and voluntary yet accountable. The UN Global Compact has a unique constellation of participants and stakeholders, bringing companies together with governments, civil society, labour, the United Nations, and other key stakeholders.

profiles.headline: Let's reinvent schools.
profiles.about:
Let's dare to say it: Yes, the teaching profession is much more complex today than it was 30 years ago. Yes, today, fewer and fewer students like to come to school to learn. Stop doublespeak.

The world has changed profoundly, and school as a system has not evolved.
By always doing more of the same thing, we get the same result: suffering, teacher shortages, academic failure, full elitist schools vs. deserted schools.

In 2016, Fanny Demeulder contacted me after reading my book "Save the school?". Since then, the one who has become my partner in both the professional and private sectors, made me remove the question mark: Save the school!

What are we proposing? Not a revolution but a profound evolution of the system.
We have built freely available educational materials and we provide training to enable teachers to boost the motivation and academic results of their students, even in heterogeneous classes. Yes, students can learn the basic building blocks faster and better, while developing 21st century skills, such as autonomy and cooperation.

A little theory, many easily actionable tools and essential principles: a simple recipe without being simplistic, which requires courage to change habits and beliefs, and hours of practice to develop the technicality of a new posture.

Our problem: we only have two heads and four arms, and we are overwhelmed with requests.

With additional resources, we could develop more materials and train more teachers.

Help us if you want our schools to become an inspiring model for the rest of the world.

Our passion is to help schools find new life. Seeing hope reborn in the eyes of students who felt like they were on a dead end. See the sacred fire rekindle in the hearts of their teachers.

Contact me today to learn more:

profiles.headline: I help teams remove ambiguity from complex IT & business projects | Business Analysis | AI-native
profiles.about:
Most IT & business projects don’t fail because of technology.
They fail because of unclear assumptions, unspoken decisions, and hidden contradictions.

My job is to remove that ambiguity before it becomes expensive.

I work on complex initiatives where:
– ideas are still vague
– stakeholders think they agree (but don’t)
– teams start building too early
– critical decisions remain implicit

I help teams:
– make assumptions explicit
– structure thinking into clear, decision-ready artifacts
– force the right decisions at the right time
– assess whether a project is actually safe to build

I have a strong technical background, which allows me to bridge business and engineering — without losing sight of what really matters: clarity.

des utilisateurs du Système d'Information pour leur apporter la solution la plus adaptée en collaboration avec les différentes parties prenantes de
la direction du Système d'Information de l'entreprise.

Je me plais également dans l'environnement de travail en Agile SCRUM depuis 2015 car il permet de renforcer encore plus l'esprit d'équipe. Une seule motivation pour toute lé'équipe :
mettre en service le produit en faisant jouer les 3 variables : périmètre, délai, budget!

Le "Pourquoi ?" étant la clé de tout produit à succès à construire, être en amont du lancement des projets stratégiques dans l'entreprise est ce qui motive
pour la suite.

experience.description:
I represent the section "Hiking" of Decathlon Anderlecht. I provide information to customers regarding the products offered by the store as well as giving the customer a great experience at Decathlon.

Moreover, Decathlon gives the opportunity to every employee to optimize the sales of his/her department by analyzing financial data and performing cross-sectional analysis across different Decathlon stores in Belgium.
Performing financial tests to challenge the new customer database that is being internally implemented and helping to update and modernize the former agents database.

The limited existence of market studies regarding the Belgian lift sector strengthened the lack of visibility on the installed base of lifts as well as identifying future potential growth opportunities. However, the previous years highlighted some legislation changes regarding the modernization of lifts depending on the year of construction. This evolution is indeed attesting to the fact that there is much to achieve for lifts companies and the Federation Agoria in order to assess the existing and future potential that can be reached in the Belgian lift sector. 

Therefore, HANS Consultancy Group has taken part in an ambitious market study on the lift sector in the Belgian landscape. The desired outcome of this market study was the realization of a map of the building landscape on three levels of analysis: national, regional and municipal. The team relied on raw data gathering from Statbel database as well as using samples from the Immoweb website in order to assess an estimate of buildings owning a lift in the Belgian Landscape. The group took the advantage of the database structure to highlight the potential growth of lifts in existing, new and future buildings. Moreover, inspired by all issues encountered throughout the project, the team listed significant limitations and recommendations.

Please contact our project supervisor Dirk De Moor (Chief expert at Agoria) and teacher Pico Lantini for further questions or recommendations regarding the project.

profiles.about:
Many executives and boards of directors recognize themselves in these situations :

→ The organization is not developing as it should.
→ The company is facing turbulences.
→ A reorganization, merger, or succession creates uncertainty and tension.
→ The board is navigating blindly due to a lack of clear information.
→ A leader finds themselves alone in front of strategic decisions.

These sensitive moments weaken governance, slow decision-making, and put the company’s long-term sustainability at risk.

That’s precisely where I step in.

Since 2016, I’ve been supporting leaders, executive committees, and boards of directors to restore :

- clarity in vision and decision-making,
- a solid yet agile structure for sustainable growth,
- and continuity that turns crises into opportunities to rebound.

My approach relies on three key levers:

1️⃣ Governance: Clarify roles, streamline decisions, and rebuild trust between the board and executive management.
2️⃣ Structuring: Align the business model, organization, processes, and tools.
3️⃣ Transformation & Success : Manage sensitive situations (M&A, succession, restructuring), lead change, and secure the future.

My approach is holistic, pragmatic, and human : combining diagnostic insight, methodological rigor, and co-construction with teams, always with a special attention to the human impact.

Over 20 years of experience and 40+ organizations supported in a world in constant transformation.

Always with the same goal: 
Structure. Transform. Success.

Want to talk or connect? Contact me here on LinkedIn or by email: info@ssen.be or visit www.ssen.be

Et une affaire vendue pour 25k€ à 65 ans avec zéro économie.Je me suis dit que je choisirais un chemin plus “stable”.Et pourtant.En 2021, je me lance comme consultant, bras droit du CEO d’une PME.Je découvre la responsabilité, la solitude des décisions, le poids stratégique qui repose dans les mains des dirigeants.Je réalise surtout une chose : ce que j’aime, ce n’est pas seulement le business.C’est aider à penser plus clairement.J'apprécie, structurer. challenger.Poser les bonnes questions.Je me forme au coaching mental.En parallèle, je développe mes compétences en accompagnement de projets business : business plan, plan financier, financement, structuration stratégique.Parce que pour challenger un entrepreneur, il faut comprendre son business.Aujourd’hui, je suis coach pour entrepreneurs.Ma mission : aider les entrepreneurs et dirigeants à clarifier leurs décisions, renforcer leur posture et avancer avec cohérence — en comprenant à la fois leur psychologie et leur modèle économique.Mes activités :- Coaching mental 1:1 pour entrepreneurs et dirigeants- Accompagnement stratégique sur business plan, financement et structuration- Formations en leadership, communication et structuration d’activité- Hôte du podcast Donne le Rythme, le média de l’entrepreneuriat belgeMes résultats :- 110+ clients accompagnés- 600+ heures de coaching- 60+ épisodes de podcastFun fact pour la route : Mon prénom a un « h » en trop à cause d’une erreur administrative à la commune. Aujourd’hui, je simplifie l’administratif pour que toi, tu évites ce genre de surprises.Tu veux avancer sans perdre de temps ?- Prends un rendez-vous gratuit sur https://rytm.odoo.com/book/62539c7e- Visite mon site : https://www.thimremy.com/ - Écris-moi : thim@thimremy.com

experience.description:
Depuis octobre 2021, je propose des accompagnements sur mesure :
- Coaching mental pour entrepreneurs et dirigeants : clarifier les décisions, renforcer la posture, structurer les priorités et avancer avec cohérence.
- Accompagnement stratégique sur les projets business : business plan, plan financier, financement et structuration d’activité.
- Formations professionnelles sur le leadership, la communication, la gestion des priorités, la vision stratégique et la gestion du stress.

Ce qui me différencie :
Avec 10+ ans d’expérience en entreprise (consultant, product manager, bras droit de CEO), j’ai évolué au cœur de la stratégie et de la prise de décision.

Je ne travaille pas uniquement sur le mental. Je cherche à comprendre en profondeur le business de mes clients pour leur apporter des insights à la fois stratégiques et humains.

Quelques chiffres clés :
- 110+ clients accompagnés depuis 2022.
- 600+ heures de coaching individuel.
- Une expertise ancrée dans la réalité professionnelle et entrepreneuriale belge.

Pourquoi travailler avec moi ?
Si tu veux clarifier ta vision, prendre des décisions plus lucides et structurer ton développement sans te disperser, je t’accompagne avec exigence et pragmatisme.

Contacte-moi : Écris-moi à thim@thimremy.com ou réserve un rendez-vous via thimremy.com pour en discuter.

Donne le Rythme, c’est le podcast qui explore l’entrepreneuriat belge sous toutes ses facettes.

Depuis novembre 2023, je vais à la rencontre d’entrepreneurs et artistes inspirants pour comprendre :
- Pourquoi ils se sont lancés.
- Comment ils transforment leurs idées en projets concrets.
- Les défis qu’ils ont affrontés et leurs plus grandes leçons.

Objectif : Inspirer, informer et divertir les (futurs) entrepreneurs, indépendants et quiconque qui a envie d'en savoir plus sur l'entrepreneuriat belge en leur offrant des témoignages authentiques et des parcours inspirants.

Chiffres clés :
- 60+ épisodes publiés.
- Invités de tous horizons : tech, culture, agro-alimentaire, sport, musique, etc.
- 5000+ écoutes par mois, et ça ne fait que commencer !

Pourquoi écouter ?
Si tu veux découvrir comment des Belges transforment leurs idées en réalité, ce podcast est fait pour toi.

Écoute ici et abonne-toi sur la plateforme de ton choix : https://linktr.ee/donnelerythme

profiles.headline: Payments & ISO 20022 Expert | Solution Design & Payment Transformation  | CBDC & AI Trends
profiles.about:
CP is  a payments professional with over 15 years of experience spanning business analysis, functional design, testing, and delivery — with deep expertise in international payments, SWIFT MT & MX standards, ISO 20022 migration, and payment engine modernization. 

Working across the full payments value chain to translate complex requirements into efficient, compliant, and scalable solutions.

My work reflects a strong focus on improving end-to-end payment journeys, enhancing interoperability, and building systems that balance speed, safety, and transparency.
